brief: A car plowed into a crowd at Berlin Pride in a suspected terror attack, killing one and injuring 16, while massive wildfires in France and Spain displaced over 300,000 people. Research papers explore AI transparency in product advisors and smart glasses for creative writing, among other HCI topics.
news_summary: A suspected Islamist terrorist drove a van into a Berlin Pride event, killing one and injuring 16, sparking a manhunt. Meanwhile, wildfires in France and Spain forced more than 300,000 people to evacuate in one of the largest peacetime operations in France.
papers_summary: Papers on HCI included a usability study of a conversational product advisor using LLMs, a needs assessment for measuring legislative associations, and a project on wearable AI for fiction writing with smart glasses.

zh.brief: 柏林同志遊行遭汽車衝撞，疑為伊斯蘭極端主義恐怖襲擊，至少1死16傷。歐洲野火迫使逾30萬人撤離。AI生成臉孔辨識研究顯示短時訓練可提升準確率。
zh.news_summary: 柏林同志驕傲遊行遇襲，嫌犯有伊斯蘭極端背景；歐洲野火肆虐，法國西班牙大規模撤離。
zh.papers_summary: 無重點中文論文。英文研究探討對話式產品顧問的可用性、AR輔助聾生學習、以及AI寫作工具等。
